observations: Input is a single parameter `body` accepted as either str or bytes.
The changed line encodes str input to UTF-8 before measuring length; bytes input is measured directly.
Return value is an integer byte count, not a character count.
Probe p1 passes a non-ASCII str ('한글'), exercising the UTF-8 encode branch.
Probe p2 passes bytes (b'AB'), exercising the direct-length branch.
Probe p3 passes an empty str, which encodes to zero bytes.
